limitations: This is a bounded local sample, not field Core Web Vitals or physical-device/Safari testing.
EventTiming durations are quantized; entries below16ms may be absent. onINP uses official interaction count/percentile handling; reportAllChanges reports metric changes, not every input.
Per-page sample count stays below50 interactions, so the sample emphasizes the worst interaction rather than a traffic-level98th percentile.
Instrumentation and this machine/network fixture can affect results. No INP is inferred from Lighthouse TBT.
The pinned actual224-product snapshot is used; home provides dish/gallery dialog samples, menu samples search and category controls.

Shared Windows host: bounded process CPU snapshots did not identify a heavy native encoder. Other Chrome/GPU work, including possible parent CapCut web editing, is not comprehensively attributable/excluded.
Controls are one bounded pass per case, not repeated-run estimates. Natural presentation gaps are retained, not reinterpreted as application handler cost.
The home case explicitly bypasses the film to sample content; this is not film/autoplay acceptance.
First-visit ACK cookie and consent localStorage were absent before server navigation and after hydration, with the visible notice tested before the intentional acknowledgement action.

causalInterpretation.mobileMenuWorst: Cookie acknowledgement: 1712ms official latency, 4.3ms click processing and about1683.9ms presentation remainder; no overlapping recorded LoAF/longtask. The span reaches the following focus action, so it cannot attribute 1.7s to cookie or CSS code.
causalInterpretation.desktopMenuWorst: Search focus: 1992ms official latency, about0.4ms pointerdown processing and1987.9ms presentation remainder. It spans the later b/u typing actions. LoAF includes later input/Scheduler work; that does not establish the focus handler caused that work.
causalInterpretation.boundedProfileProposal: One settled visible Curries category click, with CPU4 and current fixed224-item snapshot, traced with Profiler.start/stop plus main-thread trace around that action. Attribute sampled functions and forced-layout stacks before proposing a React/CSS change.
causalInterpretation.appCostEvidence: Curries click processing measured294.8ms mobile and235.4ms desktop; home photo opening measured223.5ms click processing with a LoAF reporting166.4ms forced style/layout. These justify focused attribution, not an invented function-level cause.
